2026-07-21.text: That life is long which answers life's great end.
2026-07-21.author: Edward Young

2026-07-22.text: There is no knowledge that is not power.
2026-07-22.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

2026-07-23.text: Wonder is from surprise; and surprise ceases upon experience.
2026-07-23.author: Robert South

2026-07-24.text: It takes two to speak the truth, — one to speak, and another to hear.
2026-07-24.author: Henry David Thoreau
2026-07-24.sourceTitle: A Week on the Concord and Merrimack Rivers (1849)

2026-07-25.text: To love oneself is the beginning of a life-long romance.
2026-07-25.author: Oscar Wilde
2026-07-25.sourceTitle: Phrases and Philosophies for the Use of the Young (1894)

2026-07-26.text: A well-written Life is almost as rare as a well-spent one.
2026-07-26.author: Thomas Carlyle

2026-07-27.text: The course of true love never did run smooth.
2026-07-27.author: William Shakespeare

2026-07-28.text: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
2026-07-28.author: Francis Bacon

2026-07-30.text: Familiar acts are beautiful through love.
2026-07-30.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley
